# persist revised transform for post-verdict instructions
open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid)); fg=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    lines=[[(r,c) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]+[[(r,c) for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)]
    for line in lines:
        inds=[i for i,(r,c) in enumerate(line) if grid[r][c]==fg]
        for x,y in zip(inds,inds[1:]):
            if all(grid[line[i][0]][line[i][1]] in (bg,fg) for i in range(x+1,y)):
                for i in range(x+1,y):
                    r,c=line[i]
                    if grid[r][c]==bg: a[r][c]=2
    return a
''')
